plex_url.description: Plex server URL, for example http://192.168.1.50:32400

recently_added_movies_limit.description: Maximum number of newest movies included in Recently Added. Set to 0 to exclude movies from this source only.

recently_added_tv_limit.description: Legacy TV limit retained for backward compatibility. Used as the default for show and episode limits when those are not set.

recently_added_tv_shows_limit.description: Maximum number of newest TV show/season items included in Recently Added. Set to 0 to exclude them from this source only.

recently_added_tv_episodes_limit.description: Maximum number of newest TV episodes/clips included in Recently Added. Set to 0 to exclude them from this source only.

recently_added_music_limit.description: Maximum number of newest music items included in Recently Added. Set to 0 to exclude music from this source only.

suppress_recent_episode_duplicates.description: Limit how many Recently Added episodes from the same TV show can enter the rotation pool.

recently_added_episodes_per_show.description: Maximum Recently Added episodes allowed per TV show when duplicate suppression is enabled.

recently_played_movies_limit.description: Maximum number of recently played movies included in the rotation pool. Set to 0 to exclude movies from Recently Played only.

recently_played_tv_limit.description: Maximum number of recently played TV items included in the rotation pool. Set to 0 to exclude TV from Recently Played only.

recently_played_music_limit.description: Maximum number of recently played music items included in the rotation pool. Set to 0 to exclude music from Recently Played only.

layout.description: Auto selects the ultra-wide marquee layout on very wide displays such as 320x32

artwork_width.description: Artwork tile width in pixels for marquee layout

accent_width.description: Width of the Plex-gold accent divider

show_panel_dividers.description: Draw subtle vertical guides at physical panel boundaries

panel_width.description: Physical panel width used for optional divider guides

recent_count.description: General item limit used by library and other uncategorized queries

live_priority.description: Allow active Plex playback to advertise live content priority when supported by LEDMatrix
